title: Income Tax Regimes Comparison for FY 2026-27 (Assessment Year 2027-28)
source: Income Tax Department, Government of India
content: For Assessment Year 2027-28 (FY 2026-27), the New Tax Regime is the default tax regime under Section 115BAC. The New Tax Regime features concessional tax slab rates and a standard deduction of ₹75,000 for salaried employees. Taxpayers earning taxable income up to ₹7,00,000 receive full tax rebate under Section 87A (resulting in zero net tax liability). The Old Tax Regime allows claiming specific deductions (such as Section 80C up to ₹1,50,000, 80D medical insurance, HRA exemption) but applies higher baseline slab rates.
